description:
Prototype a GPU demapper that uses the shared batch-oriented modem interface without changing the high-level API. This story is conditional work that follows the CPU scalar and SIMD implementation, and exists to measure whether demapping has a worthwhile GPU crossover.

## Background

The repository already contains a dedicated GPU kernel crate, so there is a natural place for experimental accelerator work. For this epic, GPU support is exploratory rather than mandatory: the primary deliverable is the CPU scalar and SIMD framework, and this story is used to determine whether modem demapping should also have a GPU branch.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] A GPU prototype consumes the same batch demapper input and output shape, LLR ordering, and modem metadata semantics as the CPU fast path.
- [ ] The prototype does not require a second public modem API or public API divergence from the shared modem surface.
- [ ] The crossover report records tested hardware, batch sizes, demapper mode, and the resulting ship, experimental, or defer decision.

## Notes

This story should remain conditional and should not block the core modem framework from shipping.
title: Prototype a GPU batch demapper backend
